\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 272-275 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R280-first-pass-words-from-chapters-272-275}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a complaint and an athlete.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an identity card, a tax; a line, an application, a photograph, a copy
  \item a person, parents, a sibling, twins, a brother-in-law
  \item music, a song, a story, God, an animal
  \item a feather, a tail, a nest, a plant, a creeper
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An identity card? (\textbf{\ta{அடையாள} \ta{அட்டை}}, \emph{aṭaiyāḷa aṭṭai}.) A tax; a line? (\textbf{\ta{வரி}}, \emph{vari}.) An application? (\textbf{\ta{விண்ணப்பம்}}, \emph{viṇṇappam}.) A photograph? (\textbf{\ta{புகைப்படம்}}, \emph{pukaippaṭam}.) A copy? (\textbf{\ta{நகல்}}, \emph{nakal}.) A person? (\textbf{\ta{ஆள்}}, \emph{āḷ}.) Parents? (\textbf{\ta{பெற்றோர்}}, \emph{peṟṟōr}.) A sibling? (\textbf{\ta{உடன்பிறந்தவர்}}, \emph{uṭaṉpiṟantavar}.) Twins? (\textbf{\ta{இரட்டையர்}}, \emph{iraṭṭaiyar}.) A brother-in-law? (\textbf{\ta{மைத்துனன்}}, \emph{maittuṉaṉ}.) Music? (\textbf{\ta{இசை}}, \emph{icai}.) A song? (\textbf{\ta{பாடல்}}, \emph{pāṭal}.) A story? (\textbf{\ta{கதை}}, \emph{katai}.) God? (\textbf{\ta{கடவுள்}}, \emph{kaṭavuḷ}.) An animal? (\textbf{\ta{விலங்கு}}, \emph{vilaṅku}.) A feather? (\textbf{\ta{இறகு}}, \emph{iṟaku}.) A tail? (\textbf{\ta{வால்}}, \emph{vāl}.) A nest? (\textbf{\ta{கூடு}}, \emph{kūṭu}.) A plant? (\textbf{\ta{செடி}}, \emph{ceṭi}.) A creeper? (\textbf{\ta{கொடி}}, \emph{koṭi}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 276-280 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R280-second-pass-words-from-chapters-276-280}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for darkness and shade.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item darkness, shade, a machine, a sofa, a screwdriver
  \item a team, victory, defeat, a hobby, an opinion
  \item sugarcane, okra, a peanut, a watermelon, murukku
  \item a worker, a meeting; a crowd, a manager, an engineer, a lawyer
  \item the government, a rule, a fine, a complaint, an athlete
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Darkness? (\textbf{\ta{இருட்டு}}, \emph{iruṭṭu}.) Shade? (\textbf{\ta{நிழல்}}, \emph{niḻal}.) A machine? (\textbf{\ta{இயந்திரம்}}, \emph{iyantiram}.) A sofa? (\textbf{\ta{சோபா}}, \emph{cōpā}.) A screwdriver? (\textbf{\ta{திருப்புளி}}, \emph{tiruppuḷi}.) A team? (\textbf{\ta{குழு}}, \emph{kuḻu}.) Victory? (\textbf{\ta{வெற்றி}}, \emph{veṟṟi}.) Defeat? (\textbf{\ta{தோல்வி}}, \emph{tōlvi}.) A hobby? (\textbf{\ta{பொழுதுபோக்கு}}, \emph{poḻutupōkku}.) An opinion? (\textbf{\ta{கருத்து}}, \emph{karuttu}.) Sugarcane? (\textbf{\ta{கரும்பு}}, \emph{karumpu}.) Okra? (\textbf{\ta{வெண்டைக்காய்}}, \emph{veṇṭaikkāy}.) A peanut? (\textbf{\ta{நிலக்கடலை}}, \emph{nilakkaṭalai}.) A watermelon? (\textbf{\ta{தர்பூசணி}}, \emph{tarpūcaṇi}.) Murukku? (\textbf{\ta{முறுக்கு}}, \emph{muṟukku}.) A worker? (\textbf{\ta{தொழிலாளி}}, \emph{toḻilāḷi}.) A meeting; a crowd? (\textbf{\ta{கூட்டம்}}, \emph{kūṭṭam}.) A manager? (\textbf{\ta{மேலாளர்}}, \emph{mēlāḷar}.) An engineer? (\textbf{\ta{பொறியாளர்}}, \emph{poṟiyāḷar}.) A lawyer? (\textbf{\ta{வழக்கறிஞர்}}, \emph{vaḻakkaṟiñar}.) The government? (\textbf{\ta{அரசு}}, \emph{aracu}.) A rule? (\textbf{\ta{விதி}}, \emph{viti}.) A fine? (\textbf{\ta{அபராதம்}}, \emph{aparātam}.) A complaint? (\textbf{\ta{புகார்}}, \emph{pukār}.) An athlete? (\textbf{\ta{வீரர்}}, \emph{vīrar}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
